ns2:course.label: Service Learning in Music Education
ns2:course.description: Service Learning and participatory action research in music education. Students facilitate music learning in cooperation with community partners in Champaign-Urbana, Illinois and surrounding communities. Collaborative planning, learning through inquiry, engaged scholarship, and democratic teaching practices. Student teams develop or work on ongoing projects with community teachers, musicians, or organizations. May be repeated in separate terms.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: May be repeated in separate terms.
ns2:course.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Music department.
